bookkeeping.rowText: Authored attended from F-2742-1 (the 108 MB `trace.zip` that GitHub refused for eleven hours). Astra on lane-d, two attempts (attempt 1 self-blocked on my clause, F-ATT-12; attempt 2 `00e7839ba`, 77,722 tokens, 02:28Z to 02:35Z; plus my 5-line review fix on the lane: the runner fixture now removes its `lane-evidence-receipt-*` scratch at test end, after six survived the first landing battery's fixture-teardown guard, F-TEG1-3): `commit_lane_delta` now withholds `**/test-results/**`, `**/*-results/**`, `**/trace.zip`, `**/*.webm`, `**/test-failed-*.png` and any regular `artifacts/**` file over 50,000,000 bytes (measured by `stat`), rename pairs together, each path logged `withheld …` and appended to `<run-log-stem>-withheld-paths.txt`; task-staged raw files are unstaged (baseline index entries untouched); before the commit the runner measures the index against `merge-base main HEAD` with the new `evidence-budget.mjs --staged` and withholds the largest staged `artifacts/**` blobs until the 25,000,000-byte task budget fits; a measurement error withholds the auto-commit itself with an explicit receipt (fail-closed, disk and index retained). Fixtures: 11 raw/oversized paths withheld incl. a 51,000,000-byte `big.bin`; a 26,000,006-byte staging trims its 17,000,000-byte largest file and commits 9,000,006 bytes; exactly 25,000,000 commits untouched; a rename into `x-results/` withheld both sides. `node --test scripts/evidence-budget.test.mjs` 21/21 (14 + 7 new); `runner-commit-decoupling-guard.test.sh` 13/13; `bash -n`, tsc, build green; `src/**` unchanged. Runner pointer shift +83 lines (old 565 → 648, 567 → 650); CLAUDE.md carries no runner coordinates since its 2026-09-25 compaction and the law-pointer guard is green. The live runner process runs the old code until restarted (done attended after this landing per the restart recipe). Landed attended, scripts only
